summary: A town takes down campaign signs from the right of way, a candidate and a civil-liberties group object, and the town stops and revises its sign code.
realLife: After a town removed unpermitted campaign signs, a board candidate and the ACLU objected, the town stopped enforcement, and officials began revising the code with counsel.
sources: Cape Cod Times via AOL, town took down campaign signs, then stopped (undated): https://www.aol.com/town-truro-took-down-political-091626485.html
inGame: needs: a sign-placement rule and a code-enforcement action on a candidate's signs

turns.turn: The signs stay and the rule is not tested
The town stops enforcing and rewrites the code
turns.pulledBy: a complaint and a legal letter
turns.writesBack: a revised ordinance in the council agenda
